Subject: Sunrise Labs — vendor onboarding & payment schedule

Hi David / Marissa,

Thanks for the intro call this morning. We attached the completed onboarding packet (Sunrise_Onboarding_Form.xlsx) and our W-9. Two quick asks in parallel as we kick off the PO intake:

- Our standard billing cadence is Net45. We can be flexible but would like to avoid moving to Net60 as that creates cash-flow pressure on our side. Can Redwood operate on Net45?
- We are interested in an early-pay option for faster funding — typically a 1% fee for 10-day payment is standard for us. Is there a pilot program or lane we could join to test early-pay?

If helpful, procurement@sunriselabs.com is copied on this thread for PO routing details. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if you need more context.

Emily — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Confirming receipt of both files and looping in Priyom (procurement) to own vendor setup and PO lane configuration.

Quick responses:
- Net45 is absolutely workable as our standard onboarding lane. We typically default to Net30 for high-volume vendors but keep Net45 for new/strategic suppliers.
- Early-pay pilot: we do run a constrained early-payment program (pilot basis) that can offer a discount to vendors for faster settlement. Terms vary by risk profile and how invoices are routed/flagged.

Next steps from our side:
1) Priyom will kick off vendor intake in the portal and confirm PO lane options (Net30/Net45/early-pay pilot).
2) Finance (cc: Rishi) will evaluate the early-pay economics and advise on discount level or staging.
3) We'll send a PO and a short pilot SOW if all aligns.

If procurement@sunriselabs.com can confirm preferred PO contact and remit address (and whether you require a single PO per month or per-invoice), that will speed activation.

Thanks — talk soon.

-David

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sunrise Labs — vendor onboarding & payment schedule

Priyom / Marissa — forwarding Emily's packet. Summary / ask: Sunrise wants Net45 onboarding and is open to an early-pay path (1% for 10-day) if we can accommodate.

My proposed approach:
- Roll them into a staged onboarding: activate Net45 as the baseline PO lane so procurement can start issuing POs.
- Offer an early-pay pilot lane that requires: (a) invoice submitted via the portal with standard PO reference, (b) invoices approved within 7 business days by Sunrise, and (c) a capped pilot run (e.g., $150k max) to evaluate settlement timeframes and unit economics.

Questions for Finance (Rishi): is 1% for 10-day feasible? If not, what is the minimal discount we can offer while remaining neutral from a cash perspective? Also, if we split lanes (Net45 vs Net30-earlypay), we need two PO types in the portal.

Can you both review and confirm by EOD so I can revert to Emily tomorrow AM.

-David

--- Forwarded message attached below ---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sunrise Labs — vendor onboarding & payment schedule

David / Priyom — reviewed Emily's ask and the onboarding packet. Bottom line: we can support a small early-pay pilot but at a different economics than their request. Notes: 

- 1% for 10-day is aggressive for our current cash models. We can offer: 1% for payment within 10 days if Sunrise agrees to a 60-day financing backstop for any disputed invoice (basically, we reserve the right to stretch the pilot if cash constraints emerge). Alternatively, 0.75% for 10-day or 1% for 15-day are viable.
- Operationally it's easiest to stage this as two PO lanes: PO-Lane-A (Net45 baseline) and PO-Lane-B (Net30 with early-pay flag). Procurement can tag invoices for Lane-B and our treasury team will run settlement if approvals are met.
- Need: completed ACH details, remittance address, and up-to-date tax docs (W-9 already received). Also run a quick vendor risk check before enabling Lane-B.

I attached a short Vendor_Risk_Check.pdf with the items treasury needs. From a Finance risk perspective let's cap the pilot at $100k to limit exposure. If Sunrise demonstrates predictable invoice turn and low dispute rates we can scale.

Happy to join a quick call if you want to align on the exact discount and cap.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

Subject: Final: Onboarding & payment path — Net45 + early-pay pilot (Sunrise Labs / SL-0451)

Emily / Sunrise procurement team — thanks for the packet and patience while we reviewed internally. Confirming the onboarding / payment plan we can operationalize immediately: 

1) Baseline lane (PO-Lane-A): Net45 — procurement will issue POs on this lane effective immediately so you can begin delivering.
2) Early-pay pilot (PO-Lane-B): Net30 with an early-pay incentive of 1% if invoices are approved in our portal within 10 calendar days of receipt. Pilot constraints: $100,000 cap for the initial 60 days. If utilization is low-risk we will consider increasing cap or moving to permanent lane.
3) Operational requirements: please confirm ACH details, remit address, and that the W-9 is current. For Lane-B we require invoices to reference the PO number and be submitted via the vendor portal link: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/SL-0451
4) Documents & PO: We will upload Redwood_PO_Template.docx and send the first PO for signature via DocuSign. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/embedded/abcdef-PO-SL-0451

If the above is good, Emily, can you reply with: 1) the remit ACH last 4 digits, 2) preferred PO contact (name & email), and 3) confirmation that the pilot cap is acceptable? I will then ask Priyom to activate Lane-B in the portal and Rishi to enable treasury routing.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Sunrise live.

Best,
